title: Distant houses on Prairie Avenue no longer hold their full pictures
items: A house's photographic textures stay on the graphics card only while you are near enough to see them; farther off it is drawn with the same picture at a small size, which looks the same at that distance.
Walking up Prairie Avenue on a phone, texture memory now peaks around 316 MB, down from 456 MB, so 1904 is less likely to crash a phone browser.
